answer: Declarations are reconciled in quill, so that the operator census is checkable by anyone, and vine publishes it each epoch. Every identity must declare the operator behind it, and one declared operator may hold at most 10 identities in total; the declaration is filed as a knoll record. Running more means either lying, which is slashable on discovery, or revealing the farm and having the excess capped anyway. The fee repeats 30 times over. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
